angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 911,367 km at 111.43 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.9739 +/- 0.0172 mas (same row, RUWE 0.92): 111.43 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.31 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Šubjak et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2458 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.235S/abstract): 911,367 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.05 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Šubjak et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2458 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.235S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6005 +/- 50 K from Šubjak et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2458 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.235S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Šubjak et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2458 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.235S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2458.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.225, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2458 (pscomppars): spectral type F9-F9.5, from Šubjak et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.235S/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2458 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.1 dex, from Šubjak et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.235S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2458 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.34128, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2458 (pscomppars): age 5.7 Gyr, from Šubjak et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.235S/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2458 (pscomppars): rotation period 8.9 d, from Šubjak et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.235S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2458 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.5 km/s, from Šubjak et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.235S/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.31 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.336. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
